question: The full form of FDI is ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Foreign Direct Investment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Foreign Direct Investment (FDI):
 
 
• Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) refers to the investment made by a firm or individual in one country into business interests located in another country.
 
• FDI typically involves the acquisition of tangible assets, such as real estate, factories, machinery, and other physical capital.
 
• It represents a long-term interest and control by a foreign entity in the host country’s economy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• FDI is crucial for economic development as it brings in capital, technology, and expertise to the host country.
 
• It can lead to job creation, infrastructure development, and enhanced productivity in the host economy.
 
• Understanding the components of FDI helps in formulating policies that attract and effectively utilize foreign investment.
